annotation.title_clean: AB-489 Health care professions: deceptive terms or letters: artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: AB-489 Health care professions: deceptive terms or letters: artificial intelligence
annotation.summary_en: California Assembly Bill 489 (Chapter 615, 2025) extends existing health-profession title protections to AI and generative AI developers and deployers. It prohibits AI advertising or functionality implying care or advice comes from a licensed health professional, with enforcement by licensing boards and each use counted as a separate violation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing prohibitions on implying health-care licensure are enforceable against entities that develop or deploy AI/GenAI systems.
AI terms, letters or phrases implying care is provided by a licensed natural person are prohibited.
Violations fall under the appropriate health care licensing board, which may seek injunctions.
Each use of a prohibited term is a separate violation.
Expands existing crimes, creating a state-mandated local program without reimbursement.
